# Every file a release has to carry before it is published, read by
# publish-when-complete.sh. {tag} stands for the tag, vX.Y.Z.
#
# The names without a version are what the README's download buttons link;
# the versioned ones are uploaded in the same call and listed so a release is
# never published with half of an upload.

# desktop.yml
arrowloop-windows-amd64-installer.exe
arrowloop-windows-amd64-portable.exe
arrowloop-macos-universal.dmg
arrowloop-linux-amd64
arrowloop-{tag}-windows-amd64-installer.exe
arrowloop-{tag}-windows-amd64-portable.exe
arrowloop-{tag}-macos-universal.dmg
arrowloop-{tag}-linux-amd64

# mobile.yml
arrowloop-android-arm64.apk
arrowloop-android-x86_64.apk
arrowloop-{tag}-android-arm64.apk
arrowloop-{tag}-android-x86_64.apk
